documents.title: Fax cover page – AWS Quarterly Store Count Database approval

result.summary: Fax cover sheet dated 8/31/98 from Susan Smith of Lorillard Tobacco Company's Market Planning and Information Department to Mike Mozina at MSA. The brief message transmits, as promised, an approval for the AWS Quarterly Store Count Database to begin 3rd Quarter 1998 and a table showing a significant jump in Convenience Store market importance in 2nd Quarter 1998. The cover indicates 3 pages including this page.
